description: This file implements a GitHub Copilot login command using OAuth device flow, including requesting device codes, polling for access tokens, and updating authentication profiles and configuration.

methods.name: parseJsonResponse
methods.description: Parses a JSON response and asserts its type, throwing an error if the response is invalid.

methods.name: requestDeviceCode
methods.description: Requests a device code from GitHub for OAuth device flow.

methods.name: pollForAccessToken
methods.description: Polls GitHub for an access token using the device code until success or expiration.

methods.name: githubCopilotLoginCommand
methods.description: Main function to perform GitHub Copilot login via OAuth device flow, updating profiles and configuration.
